Alex: Heads-up — we have a blocking change that needs 2x approvals before the 20:00 cut (about 30m). PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5201 — fixes a KV-cache regression that regresses latency under burst. Can @Olivia and @Sam take a look?

Maya: Are unit + e2e passing?

CI Bot: build/platform-pull/5201 — ✅ all checks passed (unit, e2e, lint) — duration: 6m 12s

Kevin: skimmed the diff, small nit in logging but not blocking. left one inline comment.

Alex: Thanks @Kevin — will push a one-line log tweak in a sec. I rebased onto latest main and forced a fresh run.

Jen: FYI — if this lands before the cutoff we need to tag it for the RC branch. Can someone remind me on merge? :clock1:

Alex: If we get 2x LGTM I’ll merge and queue the RC backport. Cutoff note: ops will start the RC freeze at 20:00 UTC.

Olivia: Reviewing now, focus on correctness for kv cache invalidation edge-case.

Sam: I can take second review in ~10m, heads down on another thing atm. If CI green and no semantic issues I can +1 after that.

Alex: Pushed the log tweak: `git commit -am "log: clarify kv cache miss path" && git push origin pr/5201-fix`

CI Bot: build/platform-pull/5201 (rerun) — ✅ checks passed — 5m 48s

Olivia: LGTM. Verified behavior on a toy repro, eviction logic looks correct. :thumbsup:

Kevin: happy to waive my nit for this window.

Sam: Just looked — LGTM from me as well. Merging once Alex confirms merge window.

Alex: Merging now and triggering RC backport. Thanks everyone.

CI Bot: merge/pull/5201 — merged into main by Alex at 1967890200. backport job started for `release/rc-2026-03`

Jen: Noted — RC backport job kicked off. Will monitor and report if any issues.

Alex: Great. Post-merge: I'll create a short post in #incidents if anything flares, but this should be a straightfix. Thanks for the quick reviews.
